This role is not limited to agent orchestration or execution workflows. It is a senior technical leadership role for how AI strengthens optimisation methods, modelling, and decision quality across both planning and execution. The remit is broader than a standalone AI feature set. It covers how AI, optimisation, and engineering come together to deliver better network decisions at scale, while also shaping agentic decision systems in Control Tower style execution environments. Role purpose The Principal AI Engineer will set the technical direction for AI-augmented optimisation and intelligent operational decisioning. This person will lead through specialists in optimisation, modelling, heuristics, analytics, and experimentation. They will define where AI can materially improve search, structural recommendations, and solver-backed workflows, while also guiding the design of multi-agent systems for reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop execution. improve search, candidate generation, structural recommendations, and decision quality • The interface between AI systems, heuristics, solver layers, optimisation services, and enterprise workflows • Patterns for when AI should recommend, act autonomously, or escalate to humans • The quality bar for experimentation, evaluation, and translation of new methods into measurable value for planners and decision-makers • Reusable intelligence patterns that can scale across both Control Tower and Network Design use cases Key responsibilities • Lead the optimisation intelligence agenda across network design, routing, vessel deployment, cargo flow, and operational decisioning • Set direction for how teams define problem structures, formulate optimisation approaches, design heuristics, and identify where AI can improve search, modelling quality, and decision outcomes Classification: Internal • Guide specialists building optimisation models, analytical components, and AI capabilities, ensuring scalability • Define how AI systems should interact with solver layers, heuristics, and optimisation services rather than treating AI as a separate layer • Lead the use of agentic AI where it adds value to reasoning, orchestration, exception handling, and human-in-the-loop decision support • Shape the innovation roadmap by identifying promising new methods and accelerating them into pilots and scaled capabilities • Raise standards across modelling practice, technical quality, experimentation discipline, and architectural judgment • Communicate assumptions, trade-offs, and limitations LLM Ecosystem Expertise: Experience with tools and libraries such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers, and OpenAI/Anthropic APIs. Model Engineering: Familiarity with prompt design, LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, PEFT), and evaluation metrics for language models. Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to translate business problems into AI-first solutions with a user-centric approach. Strong TypeScript / Node.js proficiency, or deep JavaScript experience with genuine willingness to work in TypeScript (strict mode). Python-only candidates are not a fit for this role. Hands-on RAG expertise: embeddings, vector search (pgvector or similar), chunking, and retrieval-quality optimization. A rigorous, demonstrable approach to evaluation and guardrails - able to explain how agent accuracy is measured and how hallucinations and prompt injection are prevented. Working knowledge of PostgreSQL and API integration. Strong analytical skills, clear written communication, and the ability to work closely with the backend team. Nice to have: OpenAI vision/classification pipelines, MCP (Model Context Protocol) experience. Build and own the core of Agent using the AI Agents SDK (TypeScript) and the hosted Agents API- agent instructions, tool orchestration, and per-conversation sessions. Design the agent s decision-making so it reliably understands requests in Chat and selects the correct tools to act on them. Build document-understanding pipelines that extract requirements from files in any format, including scanned documents and images via OpenAI vision. Implement retrieval (RAG) using hybrid search - pgvector embeddings plus PostgreSQL full-text - with sound chunking, versioning, and relevance tuning. Define and maintain the AI evaluation framework: build eval sets from past projects, set per-wave accuracy targets, and enforce the evaluation gate in CI so quality never regresses. Implement guardrails and prompt-injection defenses, ensuring all documents and messages are treated as data, never as instructions, and that the model performs language tasks only - never computing numbers, dates, or permissions. Deliver multilingual understanding, including mixed-language conversations, with consistent, correct responses. Continuously review agent accuracy against saved guidance, and improve the system from real usage. This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. 1-2 Yrs Analytical, Postgresql, Typescript, Integration, Searching, Orchestration, Analytical Skill, Vector

jobs.title: Intern - Software Development
jobs.description: About GoKwik GoKwik is building the growth operating system for D2C and eCommerce brands, helping businesses optimise checkout, reduce RTO, enable payments, drive retention, and strengthen post-purchase engagement. With 15,000+ merchants globally and a growing presence across India, the UK, Europe, and the US, GoKwik is building AI-powered infrastructure that enables brands to grow faster and operate better. Why This Role Matters We are an engineering-led technology company building and operating large-scale commerce infrastructure. Our multi-tenant platform serves multiple independent businesses, managing their catalogues, orders, inventory, pricing and customer data while handling millions of API calls every week. We are looking for a Software Development Intern who wants to work on real production systems, build scalable applications and solve engineering challenges that directly impact businesses. You will be part of an engineering team, taking ownership of well-defined tasks from development to release, with mentorship from experienced engineers. We follow an AI-first engineering approach, and you will be encouraged to use AI coding tools across development, testing and debugging while maintaining complete ownership and understanding of everything you build. What Youll Own Work on live services and take engineering tasks end to end, from understanding requirements and planning to development, testing, code reviews and release. Build and extend REST APIs using Node.js and TypeScript, with appropriate input validation, error handling and pagination. Develop and improve frontend components in React and TypeScript, including tables, forms and admin console interfaces. Write SQL queries, work with relational databases and understand query performance and indexing. Develop unit and integration tests and contribute to improving application reliability. Debug production issues using logs, monitoring tools and systematic problem-solving. Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar tools for coding, testing, debugging and documentation. Contribute to LLM-powered features and internal tools, including prompt engineering and structured outputs. Participate in code reviews, incorporate feedback and follow engineering best practices. Who You Are Pursuing or recently completed a B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong fundamentals in Data Structures, Algorithms, problem-solving and debugging. Hands-on programming experience in JavaScript/TypeScript (preferred) or another mainstream programming language. At least one end-to-end project, preferably involving a backend API or web application, that you can explain in depth. Basic understanding of SQL, including joins, filtering, aggregations and database indexes. Understanding of web fundamentals, including HTTP, REST APIs, status codes and client-server architecture. Regular experience using AI coding tools, with the ability to evaluate and validate AI-generated code. Familiarity with Git, pull requests and basic code review workflows. Strong communication skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn. Why GoKwik At GoKwik, you will work on real-world engineering challenges and production systems rather than isolated projects. You will gain hands-on experience building scalable technology, working with modern engineering stacks and using AI tools as part of your development workflow, while learning directly from experienced engineers.
